title: UI风格#70 - Silk Road (丝绸之路)
description: 创建第70种UI风格：丝绸之路风格 - 古代商路、玉石色彩、驼铃声声。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Silk Road style When color palette Then features desert sand, jade green, lapis blue, silk gold
Given Silk Road style When typography Then uses exotic fonts: Noto Serif SC, Scheherazade New, or Cormorant
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Noto Serif SC (Chinese body 0.95rem), Cormorant (headers 3.2rem 600 weight), Scheherazade New (tagline 1.2rem)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Silk Road style When layout Then desert dunes, caravan routes, oasis motifs
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: parchment texture background, jade-green/lapis-blue radial gradients, desert sand colors, silk gold accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Silk Road style When UI elements Then silk textures, jade borders, sand effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: silk gold border gradient, jade-green/silk-gold/lapis-blue top borders on cards, caramel borders, parchment backgrounds

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Silk Road UI When functional Then includes caravan chat, merchant agents, trade stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: oasis chat, 4 merchant agents (Silk/Spice/Jade/Camel) with Silk/Worth/Spice/Rarity/Gems/Quality/Cargo/Endure stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Silk Road UI When copy Then uses ancient trade: 'Caravan', 'Spice', 'Silk', 'Oasis'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'CARAVAN. SPICE. SILK.', tagline 'Along the ancient Silk Road', button 'TRADE', greeting 'The caravan rests at this oasis', status 'Trading'/'Idle', nav 'Desert'/'Caravans'/'Archives'/'Bazaar'
